name: website-exploration
display_name: 授权网站探索与证据报告技能
description: 用 Playwright 探索用户明确授权的同域网站，生成页面证据、截图与中文探索报告；危险操作拦截、凭据脱敏、验证码即停。
capabilities: session-based browser exploration with explicit scope control (current/section/subtree/site)
navigation map and element observation with stable element ids
optional configured login with captcha/MFA stop and account masking
dangerous action interception (payment, deletion, account closure, publishing)
credential redaction in evidence and reports (URL params, Authorization/Bearer, key=value)
Markdown report, JSON pages/events evidence, screenshots, optional DOCX function list
skill-local virtualenv and Playwright Chromium via bootstrap.py; runtime binds to 127.0.0.1 only

dependencies.network: outbound to the authorized target site only; runtime listens on 127.0.0.1
